run_tridentnet_training: run the TridentNet training script with a config file and GPU arguments via the CLI
run_tridentnet_evaluation: run the TridentNet model in eval-only mode to test on a COCO dataset using saved weights
build_tridentnet_evaluator: build a COCOEvaluator for the TridentNet Trainer class to evaluate detection results on a dataset
setup_tridentnet_config: setup the TridentNet configuration by merging a config file with command-line options and freezing it
launch_tridentnet_multigpu: launch the TridentNet training across multiple GPUs and machines using detectron2 distributed launch
